payload.title: Reconstruct structural evidence from test-available logs
payload.statement: Explicit typewell/horizontal GR alignment, particle filtering, and whole-well trellis inference can recover part of the missing structural-position signal using only MD, X, Y, Z, GR, TVT_input, and typewell TVT/GR.
payload.evidence_for: E004 shows summary GR/typewell features are insufficient but does not test path alignment. Winning-note evidence reports useful PF/trellis diversity, and the strongest unavailable E003 signal is structural context.
payload.evidence_against: Repeated GR motifs, missing toe GR, long horizons, and path-search ambiguity may make the signal too weak or unstable.
payload.next_test: E005: independent PF and trellis OOF paths with shuffled-GR, no-GR fallback, repeated-fold, tail, runtime, and residual-correlation controls.
